en.title: Discount Tags
en.description:
From tag values that may be positive or negative, choose any number of them (possibly none) so that the sum is even; find the maximum possible even sum. The source guarantees at least one even number.

This site uses a standard input/output protocol.
en.input: The first line contains n; the second line contains n integers. Constraints added by this site: 1≤n≤100000, |val[i]|≤10^9.
en.explanation: First take all positive numbers to get the maximum sum; if it is odd, compare two fixes: removing the smallest positive odd number, or adding the negative odd number closest to 0.
hints: First take all positive numbers to get the maximum sum; if it is odd, compare two fixes: removing the smallest positive odd number, or adding the negative odd number closest to 0.
